components.title: Problem
components.text: Valid only on the day, when most members were nowhere near a store

footnote: At RMB 186 per birthday table, 360,000 extra tables is about RMB 67 million in sales
notes: My first proof point is birthday coupons. The problem was simple: the coupon only worked on the birthday itself, and on that day most people are at work or travelling, nowhere near a store. I changed two things. We now send it seven days early and it stays valid for fourteen days. Redemption went from 12% to 27%. We send about 2.4 million a year, so that's 360,000 more birthday tables a year, roughly RMB 67 million in sales at RMB 186 a table.
